accreditationDateIssued.description: The date when the accreditation was formally approved/issued

accreditedInJurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction for which the accreditation is valid. It should be provided using the Administrative territorial unit Authority Table (ATU) controlled vocabulary.

expiryDate.description: The date when the accreditation expires or was expired

type.description: The type of the accreditation. It should be provided using the EDC Controlled List of Accreditation Types, (http://publications.europa.eu/resource/dataset/accreditation).

country.description: The address country code. It should be provided using the Country Named Authority List

description.description: A free text description of the European Digital Credential.

title.description: The title of the European Digital Credential. One value per language is permitted.

credentialSchema.description: The schema of the european digital credential

credentialStatus.description: The status of the european digital credential

expirationDate.description: The date when the credential expires. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

identifier.description: An alternative identifier of the European Digital Credential for Learning typically assigned to the credential by the issuing organisation.

issuanceDate.description: Defines the date and time, when the European Digital Credential becomes valid. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

owner.description: The person (subject) about which claims are made and who owns the credential. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

proof.description: The proof of the european digital credential.

termsOfUse.description: The terms of use of european digital credential.

validFrom.description: The earliest date when the information associated with the credential subject property became valid. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

Latitude.description: The geographic coordinate that specifies the north / south position of the geomerty of the Earth's surface

Longitude.description: The geographic coordinate that specifies the east / west position of the geomerty of the Earth's surface

identifier.description: An identifier of the grading scheme

educationSubject.description: An associated field of education from a different semantic framework than the ISCED classification.

educationalLevel.description: An associated level of education within a semantic framework describing education levels.

homepage.description: The homepage of the learning achievement specification

influencedBy.description: Activities that a person can perform to acquire the expected learning outcomes.

maximumDuration.description: The maximum duration (in months) that a person may use to complete the learning opportunity for which this learning achievement specification is designed.

volumeOfLearning.description: The estimated number of hours the learner is expected to spend engaged in learning to earn the award. This would include the notional number of hours in, in group work, in practicals, as well as hours engaged in self-motivated study.

GradeStatus.description: The status of the grade, which can be i) pass, ii) fail or iii) other. It should be provided using a controlled vocabulary.

awardedBy.description: The awarding details of the learning assessment.

dateIssued.description: The date when the learning assessment was formally approved/issued.

location.description: The location where the learning assessment was completed

methodOfAssessment.description: Method of assessment supervision and ID verification. It should be provided using the EDC Controlled List of Methods Of Supervision And Verification.

methodOfAssessmentSupervisionAndIDVerifi.description: Method of assessment supervision and ID verification. It should be provided using the EDC Controlled List of Methods Of Supervision And Verification.

alternativeName.description: The alternative name of the learning assessment specification

assessedBy.description: The competent body that awarded the grade.

category.description: The category of the learning assessment specification as a string.

desccription.description: A free text description of the learning assessment

generalisationOf.description: A learning assessment specification (e.g., a standard) of which this specification is a generalisation.

gradingScheme.description: A set of criteria that measures varying levels of achievement

homeage.description: The homepage of the learning assessment specification.

identifier.description: An identifier of the learning assessment specification.

language.description: The language of instruction. It should be provided using the Language Named Authority List

lastModificationDate.description: The date when the learning assessment specification was last modified

mode.description: The mode of learning and or assessment (i.e., online, blended, presential, work based). It should be provided using the EDC Controlled List of Modes Of Learning and Assessment.

moreInformation.description: An additional free text note about the learning assessment specification.

otherDocuments.description: A public web document containing additional documentation about the learning assessment specification.

proves.description: The learning achievement (and related learning outcomes) this assessment is designed to test

specialisationOf.description: A learning assessment specification (e.g., a standard) of which this specification is a specialisation.

status.description: The publication status of the learning assessment specification.

title.description: The title of the learning assessment specification. One value per language is permitted.

type.description: The type of learning assessment. It should be provided using the EDC Controlled List of Assessments Types

validWith.description: The organisation which acknowledges the entitlement (i.e., the organisation offering the learning opportunity, membership or employment opportunity).

address.description: An address associated with the location

alternativeName.description: The alternative name of the organisation

legalName.description: The legal name of the organisation

registration.description: The legal identifier of an organisation. The identifier given to a registered organisation by the authority with which it is registered. The legal status of a registered organisation is conferred on it by an authority within a given jurisdiction. The Legal Identifier is therefore a fundamental relationship between an organisation and the authority with which it is registered.

citizenship.description: The country (or countries) that conferred citizenship rights on the person. It should be provided using the Country Named Authority List

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the person

familyName.description: The family name of the person

gender.description: The gender of the person. It should be provided using the Human Sex Named Authority List

givenName.description: The given name of the person

lastModificationDate.description: The date when the person (information) was last modified

nationalId.description: The 'primary' national identifier of the person

placeOfBirth.description: The place of birth of the person

phoneNumber.description: The full phone number as a string

label.description: The label of the histogram score or score range. Should correspond to the grading scheme which has been used, e.g., 'C', or '20-30'

higherPercentage.description: The percentage of students of the same course who got a higher grade.

lowerPercentage.description: The percentage of students of the same course who got a lower grade.
